demoBanner: Demo data: everything on this site is made up.
homeIntro: This is a proof of concept of the church website and members area.
signinIntro: Enter your email address and we will send you a link to sign in. There is no password.
signinSent: If that address belongs to a member who can sign in, a link is on its way. It works once and expires soon.
signinLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
signinInvalid: That does not look like an email address. Please check it and try again.
signinConfirmBody: Select the button to sign in on this device.
signinBadLinkBody: The link has expired, has already been used, or is not valid. Ask for a new one.
signinEmailBody:
Hello,

Use this link to sign in to {{site}}:

{{url}}

It works once and expires in {{minutes}} minutes. If you did not ask for it, you can ignore this email.
outboxIntro: Nothing here was sent. This is every email the fake sender has been given since the server started.
